## IrmRouter #1

Inverts the one-time initialization guard, so an initialized router can be initialized again and its roles reset.

- **Mutant:** [`1.sol`](1.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`rvIrrInitializeAlwaysReverts`](../../specs/IrmRouter/IrmRouter_properties.spec#L223)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh IrmRouter 1`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/IrmRouter/properties.conf --rule rvIrrInitializeAlwaysReverts`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
@@ -54,7 +54,7 @@

     /// @inheritdoc IIrmRouter
     function initialize(address owner_, address manager_) external {
-        require(!isInitialized, ErrorsLib.ALREADY_INITIALIZED);
+        require(isInitialized, ErrorsLib.ALREADY_INITIALIZED);

         isInitialized = true;
         _transferOwnership(owner_);
```

## IrmRouter #2

Inverts the check that a market names this router as its rate model, so only foreign markets can be routed.

- **Caught by:** [`rvIrrSetMarketIrmRevertsOnGuardFailure`](../../specs/IrmRouter/IrmRouter_properties.spec#L233)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh IrmRouter 2`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
@@ -75,7 +75,7 @@
         _checkAuthorized();
         require(address(irm) != address(0), OwnerManagerErrors.ZERO_ADDRESS);
         // The id commits to the `irm` field: a foreign address would route a phantom market.
-        require(marketParams.irm == address(this), ErrorsLib.NOT_ROUTER_MARKET);
+        require(marketParams.irm != address(this), ErrorsLib.NOT_ROUTER_MARKET);

         Id id = marketParams.id();

```

## IrmRouter #3

Inverts the zero address guard in setMarketIrm, so routing installs the zero address and unroutes a configured market.

- **Mutant:** [`3.sol`](3.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`vtIrrRoutedMarketNeverUnroutes`](../../specs/IrmRouter/IrmRouter_properties.spec#L9)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh IrmRouter 3`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/IrmRouter/properties.conf --rule vtIrrRoutedMarketNeverUnroutes`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
@@ -73,7 +73,7 @@
     /// used `AdaptiveCurveIrm` resumes from its frozen `rateAtTarget`, not from `initialRateAtTarget`.
     function setMarketIrm(MarketParams memory marketParams, IIrm irm) external {
         _checkAuthorized();
-        require(address(irm) != address(0), OwnerManagerErrors.ZERO_ADDRESS);
+        require(address(irm) == address(0), OwnerManagerErrors.ZERO_ADDRESS);
         // The id commits to the `irm` field: a foreign address would route a phantom market.
         require(marketParams.irm == address(this), ErrorsLib.NOT_ROUTER_MARKET);

```

## IrmRouter #4

Inverts the Morpho-only gate on borrowRate, locking Morpho out and letting anyone else drive accrual.

- **Mutant:** [`4.sol`](4.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`rvIrrBorrowRateRevertsOnGuardFailure`](../../specs/IrmRouter/IrmRouter_properties.spec#L247)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh IrmRouter 4`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/IrmRouter/properties.conf --rule rvIrrBorrowRateRevertsOnGuardFailure`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
@@ -99,7 +99,7 @@

     /// @inheritdoc IIrm
     function borrowRate(MarketParams memory marketParams, Market memory market) external returns (uint256) {
-        require(msg.sender == MORPHO, ErrorsLib.NOT_MORPHO);
+        require(msg.sender != MORPHO, ErrorsLib.NOT_MORPHO); // MUTATION: inverted trust gate locks Morpho out and lets anyone else in

         IIrm irm = marketIrm[marketParams.id()];
         require(address(irm) != address(0), ErrorsLib.IRM_NOT_SET);
```

```diff
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
@@ -102,7 +102,7 @@
         require(msg.sender == MORPHO, ErrorsLib.NOT_MORPHO);

         IIrm irm = marketIrm[marketParams.id()];
-        require(address(irm) != address(0), ErrorsLib.IRM_NOT_SET);
```

```diff
@@ -110,7 +110,7 @@

     function borrowRateView(MarketParams memory marketParams, Market memory market) external view returns (uint256) {
         IIrm irm = marketIrm[marketParams.id()];
-        require(address(irm) != address(0), ErrorsLib.IRM_NOT_SET);
```

## IrmRouter #8

Routes every market to the router itself instead of the supplied implementation, so each route is a self-loop.

- **Mutant:** [`8.sol`](8.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`utIrrSetMarketIrmRoutesTheMarket`](../../specs/IrmRouter/IrmRouter_properties.spec#L79)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh IrmRouter 8`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/IrmRouter/properties.conf --rule utIrrSetMarketIrmRoutesTheMarket`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
@@ -89,7 +89,7 @@
             irm.borrowRate(marketParams, market);
         }

-        marketIrm[id] = irm;
+        marketIrm[id] = IIrm(marketParams.irm); // MUTATION: writes the market's committed irm field, the router itself, instead of the new implementation
         emit MarketIrmSet(id, address(irm));
     }

```

## IrmRouter #9

Writes each route under the zero id instead of the market id, so the market stays unrouted.

- **Mutant:** [`9.sol`](9.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`utIrrSetMarketIrmTouchesOnlyItsOwnMarket`](../../specs/IrmRouter/IrmRouter_properties.spec#L96) · [`utIrrSetMarketIrmRoutesTheMarket`](../../specs/IrmRouter/IrmRouter_properties.spec#L79)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh IrmRouter 9`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/IrmRouter/properties.conf --rule utIrrSetMarketIrmTouchesOnlyItsOwnMarket utIrrSetMarketIrmRoutesTheMarket`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
@@ -89,7 +89,7 @@
             irm.borrowRate(marketParams, market);
         }

-        marketIrm[id] = irm;
+        marketIrm[Id.wrap(bytes32(0))] = irm; // MUTATION: staged routing leftover writes the zero placeholder key instead of the market's id
         emit MarketIrmSet(id, address(irm));
     }

```

## IrmRouter #10

Drops the market id derivation, so every route lands on the zero id row.

- **Mutant:** [`10.sol`](10.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`vsIrrZeroIdNeverRouted`](../../specs/IrmRouter/IrmRouter_valid_state.spec#L35)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh IrmRouter 10`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/IrmRouter/valid_state.conf --rule vsIrrZeroIdNeverRouted`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
@@ -77,7 +77,7 @@
         // The id commits to the `irm` field: a foreign address would route a phantom market.
         require(marketParams.irm == address(this), ErrorsLib.NOT_ROUTER_MARKET);

-        Id id = marketParams.id();
+        Id id; // MUTATION: id derivation dropped in a refactor, leaving the routing key default initialized to zero

         // Only a live market is accrued and probed: a pre-creation probe would prematurely write a stateful
         // model's rateAtTarget, and a repeated one would then decay it over the whole epoch.
```

## IrmRouter #11

Clears a market's route when borrowRate reads it, so the first accrual after routing unroutes the market.

- **Mutant:** [`11.sol`](11.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`utIrrBorrowRateRoutesAndWritesNothing`](../../specs/IrmRouter/IrmRouter_properties.spec#L111)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh IrmRouter 11`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/IrmRouter/properties.conf --rule utIrrBorrowRateRoutesAndWritesNothing`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-router/IrmRouter.sol
@@ -101,7 +101,7 @@
     function borrowRate(MarketParams memory marketParams, Market memory market) external returns (uint256) {
         require(msg.sender == MORPHO, ErrorsLib.NOT_MORPHO);

-        IIrm irm = marketIrm[marketParams.id()];
+        IIrm irm = marketIrm[marketParams.id()]; delete marketIrm[marketParams.id()]; // MUTATION: consume on use leftover clears the route as soon as it is read
         require(address(irm) != address(0), ErrorsLib.IRM_NOT_SET);

         return irm.borrowRate(marketParams, market);
```
